ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
let res = JSON.parse(result);
let book_list = [];
if (res.data.search_data) {
  for (let item of res.data.search_data) {
    if (item.books && Array.isArray(item.books)) {
      book_list = book_list.concat(item.books);
    }
  }
}
JSON.stringify(book_list)
</js>$[*]
